name: One-Skillet Pesto Mozzarella Chicken
reason: No catalog collision: the only pesto recipe in the 544-recipe digest is 'turkey-pesto-pasta-kale' (different protein, pasta base, kale not tomato/zucchini/mozzarella), and no chicken skillet in the catalog carries a basil-pesto or fresh-mozzarella/caprese profile. Distinct from accepted 'creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet', which is a creamy garlic/parmesan cream-sauce dish, not a basil-pesto + melted-mozzarella seared skillet.
cross_protein_collision_note: Structurally a pesto + fresh-mozzarella + tomato/zucchini seared-cutlet skillet. A turkey-cutlet or pork-cutlet 'pesto mozzarella' skillet in another selector's pool would be the same dinner on a different protein - flag for the decider's cross-protein merge. Note the existing turkey-pesto-pasta-kale shares only the pesto flavor family, not the dish.
unmapped_ok: Carries jarred basil pesto and fresh sliced mozzarella as intentional unmapped picks to exercise the pricer lane - not penalized per v2.1 s5.1.
